# mg34-windowsgl

Original synthetic code written for this repository. It contains no third-party code or assets and is released under the repository license.

## Purpose

An old MonoGame 3.4 WindowsGL project: `Assemblies\WindowsGL` HintPaths, a `Tao.Sdl` reference, and references to `MonoGame.Framework.Net` and `Lidgren.Network`. It has no `MonoGame.Common.props` import (that file first shipped in 3.5). It is never built.

## Positive for

MG003, MG004, MG011, MG018, MG021, MG022.
